typeCheck: New send-spy assertion inferred only the string overload, producing never for object payloads. Reused unknown-payload helper; runtime assertion unchanged.
browserRestart: Manual goto raced Vite automatic restart navigation; driver now observes that actual navigation and verifies HTTP500 from replacement server.
browserManifestRequest: Environment module.url was a raw virtual identifier, not an HTTP URL; Node fetch rejected its scheme. Driver now requests the existing /@id/__x00__ virtual-module HTTP route.
hmrContract: The test app explicitly accepts the virtual manifest update, as required for preserving state along that importer. The adapter delegates loaded-module propagation to Vite; applications without an accepting boundary can still require a full reload.
firstUpdate: Vite client reloads itself when its first update sees an overlay; server emitted only js-update. Added explicit successful HMR setup to match the existing recovery/state-preservation contract, retaining the first-update observation and source evidence.
runtimeReadiness: Authored CSS pixels and JS entry readiness do not prove runtime initialization. Added runtime-only CSS probe before steady-state HMR; HMR during initialization remains a separate unverified candidate with its original trace retained.
